column1: # Every test of a run group that smart_stu2_2_expected.json does not expect
# to pass, with why (#520). scripts/inferno/lane.sh fails a run whose
# expected results hold any other test to anything but `pass`, and warns once
# the issue of a `pending` row is closed. Columns: test id, kind (`pending`:
# a FerroSMART step will make it pass; `downstream`: the test reads the
# resource server, never FerroSMART; `omitted`: the kit itself omits the
# test for the run's inputs), issue or `-`, reason.

column4: the kit omits the token exchange's CORS check for a non-public client, as SMART App Launch 2.2.0, App Launch, Considerations for CORS support asks CORS of servers for browser-based apps; groups 1 and 4 run it with the public client
